name: MERCURIUS IODATUS RUBER
head_symptoms: Coryza and dull hearing; right side of nose hot. Hawks mucus from posterior nares. Turbinated bones swollen. Boggy mucus membrane of nose and throat; closure of Eustachian tube, opening with a pop.
skin_symptoms: Small fissures and cracks; hard papules; Hunterian chancre; syphilitic ulcers. Bubo. Sarcocele.

source.title: MERCURIUS IODATUS RUBER - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
